correctness.rationale: For a nondegenerate triangle, Gerretsen gives s^2 <= 4R^2+4Rr+3r^2 and Euler gives t=r/R<=1/2. The derived coefficient Phi(t)=2(4+3t)/(sqrt(4+4t+3t^2)+2) has derivative sign 8-12t+12sqrt(4+4t+3t^2)>0 on (0,1/2], yielding p-4R <= (6sqrt(3)-8)r. Lattice-freeness implies r<=sqrt(2)/2 by the square-lattice covering radius. No finite experiment is used to infer the infinite claim.
